the blanching followed by fluidized bed drying was the best approach for OFSP flour and porridge production.
blanched and fluidized bed drying was observed to be the best approach in terms of chemical composition, functional property and microbial quality of the orange fleshed sweet potato.
blanching and fluidized bed drying were the best pre-treatments to retain the nutrients and sensory quality of OFSP flour and porridge.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel and efficient drying method (fluidized bed drying) for OFSP.
improving the quality of the OFSP by pre-treatments (blanching and chemical) and drying methods (sun, solar, and FB) to enhance the quality of the product.
the effect of pre treatments and drying methods on chemical composition, functional and microbial quality of OFSP porridge.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the blanching followed by FB drying of OFSP is the most suitable method to produce high quality and acceptable OFSP flour and porridge.
blanching and fluidized bed drying techniques were the most appropriate in retaining the nutritional and functional properties of orange fleshed sweet potato flour.
the blanching with FB drying techniques were observed to have better retention of the nutrients in OFSP flour and porridge.

OFSP porridge can be used as a good source of energy, protein, carbohydrate, and β-carotene.

the blanching followed by FB drying of OFSP could be a good alternative to improve the nutritional value of OFSP flour and porridge for food processing industry and food service sector.
